name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
February 12, 2013
  7:00 P.M.
  Council Chambers of City Hall
  340 Palos Verdes Dr. West
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to
on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If
applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office during normal business
hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make
inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours
prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however,
to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a
presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council shall
fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits
the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific
agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City
Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of
items shown on the agenda.

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R13-11
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 13-702

CALL TO ORDER

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
February 12, 2013
  1
 PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM(S)

CLOSED SESSION (7:00 p.m. - 7:30 p.m.)

This time has been set aside for the City Council to meet in a closed session to discuss the
matters listed below pursuant to Government Code §54957 and §54957.6. The Mayor or City
Attorney will give an additional oral report regarding the closed session.

    PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT
  Government Code §54957
  Title: Interim City Manager

    CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  Government Code §54957.6
  City Representative: City Attorney Christi Hogin
  Unrepresented Employee: Interim City Manager

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

At the conclusion of the Closed Session, the Council may continue any item(s) listed on the
closed session agenda to the Open Session agenda for discussion or to take formal action as it
may deem appropriate.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL (7:30 PM)

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

    Swearing-In of Disaster Service Workers and Certificate of Recognition to Bryant
  Winchell/NART (Mayor Bird)

MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 11)

All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion,
unless a Councilmember, staff, or member of the public requests that an item be removed for
separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered
immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.

1.  Waive Further Reading

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
February 12, 2013
  2
   Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of
  ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption
  on second reading.

2.  City Council Minutes of January 22, 2013

  Recommendation: Review and Approve.

3.  City Treasurer's Report - January 2013

  Recommendation: Receive and File.

4.  Monthly Financial Report - January 2013

  Recommendation: Receive and File.

5.  Resolutions Declaring that Weeds, Brush, Rubbish and Refuse Upon or in Front of
  Specified Properties in the City are a Seasonal and Recurrent Public Nuisance, and
  Declaring its Intention for the Abatement Thereof

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolutions
  R13-05 and R13-06, setting protest hearings for February 26, 2013.

6.  Resolution R13-07; Approving FY 2012-13 Mid-Year Budget Adjustments and General
  Fund Transfer

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R13-
  07, approving FY12-13 mid-year budget adjustments and general fund transfer.

7.  Resolution R13-08; Adopting a Revised Expenses Reimbursement Policy and Rescinding
  R06-08

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R13-
  08; approving a revised expense reimbursement policy.

8.  Resolution R13-10; Authorizing the Destruction of Obsolete Records of the City Clerk,
  Police, and Building, Planning and Public Works Departments

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R13-
  10; authorizing the destruction of specific obsolete records of the City Clerk, Police,
  and Building, Planning and Public Works Departments.

9.  Special Event Application by the Palos Verdes Art Center to Hold its Annual "Homes
  Tour Extraordinaire" on Friday and Saturday, April 12-13, 2013

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
February 12, 2013
  3
   Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special
  Event Application allowing the Palos Verdes Art Center to hold its annual "Homes
  Tour Extraordinaire" on Friday and Saturday, April 12-13, 2013 from 10:00 a.m. to
  4:00 p.m.

10.  Special Event Application for Palos Verdes Community Art Association Affiliates
  Summer Art Shows: April 27-28, May 18-19, June 22-23, July 20-21, August 17-18,
  September 21-22, 2013 from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on the Malaga Cove Plaza Green

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special
  Event Application for PVCAA Art Shows scheduled one week per month from April
  through September, 2013.

11.  Special Event Application for a Charity Bike Ride for Habitat for Humanity of Greater
  Los Angeles Scheduled for April 6, 2013

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request to
  allow the "Palos Verdes Ride" for Habitat for Humanity of Greater Los Angeles to
  travel through Palos Verdes Estates on Saturday, April 6, 2013 from 7:30 a.m. to
  3:00 p.m.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT
on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters
presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be
referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.

PUBLIC HEARINGS - 7:30 PM

All persons addressing the City Council during public hearings shall be limited to three (3)
minutes for comment, except for an Appellant/Applicant, which shall be provided five (5)
minutes for presentation and rebuttal.

OLD BUSINESS

NEW BUSINESS

12.  Resolution R13-09; Appointing Daniel Dreiling as Interim City Manager and Approval of
  Employment Agreement

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R13-
  09, appointing Daniel Dreiling as Interim City Manager and approving the
  employment agreement.

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
February 12, 2013
  4
 13.  Approval of Amendment to the FY 2013 Palos Verdes Golf Club Capital Budget to
  Implement the Club's 2013 Long Range Plan Projects

  Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council approve an amendment of
  $1.3 million to the FY 2013 Palos Verdes Golf Club Capital Budget to implement the
  Club's 2013 Long Range Plan projects.

STAFF REPORTS

14.  City Manager's Report

DEMANDS

15.  Demands of February 12, 2013

  Recommendation: Authorize Payment of Motions #1 and #2.

  a.  Motion #1 - Payroll Warrant of February 1, 2013
  b.  Motion #2 - Warrant Register of February 12, 2013

MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

16.  Council Attendance at PVP Chamber "Salute to Business" Awards Event Thursday,
  March 14, 2013

ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 26, 2013, IN COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF
CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.

    This City Council meeting can be viewed on Cox Cable, Channel 35, Wednesday,
  February 13, 2013 at 7:30 p.m., and Wednesday, February 20, 2013, at 7:30 p.m.

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing
agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to
Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos
Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting in
accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 8th day of February, 2013.

  Vickie Kroneberger, CMC
  Executive Assistant/Deputy City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
